title: 第十八章 巧了!
content_zh:
铸魔洞窟内，李磊将那几件宝物重新装入乾坤袋中，收拾好后李磊二话不说，立刻转身掉头朝出口处飞奔而去。

    他实在不想在这个破地方多待一秒，多浪费一分时间了。

    但并不是因为李磊胆小，主要是这铸魔洞窟属实有些诡异，仿佛有无尽的秘密还没有被李磊发觉出来。

    另外一个原因，李磊真的很赶时间，他实在是太想飞升成仙，太想知道天上到底是什么样子。

    他这种情绪就好比谁家小孩拆生日礼物，一旦得到了生日礼物，就必须立刻马上拆开，否则那就是一种煎熬。

    “你怎么这么着急要投胎啊，不在这歇息会就走吗”石头笑着问道。

    “对对对，我去投胎，你说啥是啥!”李磊应付道。

    “哎呀！”

    “砰!”

    不出意外的话，意外果然发生了。

    李磊眼看马上就要出去了，可是，铸魔洞窟洞口突然出现一个金色的屏障，正正好好把洞口给封上了。

    面对这突如其来的屏障李磊更是措手不及，根本没有办法停下脚步，只好以最快的速度结结实实的撞向屏障，没错刚才那声惨叫就是李磊发出的。

    “奶奶的，给我玩阴的是吧，破石头不让我出去就直说”李磊捂着头上刚撞还热乎的包骂道，可以看出这力道可真是不小，但那金色的屏障却丝毫没有损伤。
content_en:
"Hoo~"

"Cough cough cough"

Taibai Jinxing breathed a sigh of relief and coughed a few times, adjusted his mood, forced a smile and said to Erlang Shen: "In fact, sometimes geniuses are often not very eye-catching. Most geniuses have accumulated a lot of experience, and when they grow up, they can despise all living beings."

"What's more, the triple thunder tribulation really happened, right among their crowd, didn't it?" Taibai Jinxing asked in return.

However, after hearing Taibai Jinxing's words, Erlangshen ignored them completely, and his expression did not even change.

This clearly shows that Taibaijinxing is not taken seriously, indeed! So what does Taibaijinxing mean to Erlang Shen?

Faced with Erlangshen ignoring him like this, Taibaijinxing could do nothing, let alone get angry. Although Taibaijinxing's cultivation was so tyrannical and he was already in the middle stage of Taiyi Golden Immortal, Erlangshen, who was known as the No. 1 God of War in Heaven, was not a vegetarian. His cultivation was already in the late stage of Hunyuan Yiqi Taiyi Jinxian!

Just relying on Erlang Shen's most basic cultivation level, Taiyi Jinxian is already far ahead of Taibai Jinxing in the late stage, not to mention Hunyuan Yiqi. Hunyuan Yiqi has a counter-war cultivation level. In addition, Erlangshen's own superior strength and Hunyuan Yiqi make Taiyi Jinxian Perfect have few opponents. If he uses his full strength, he can even fight with Daluo Jinxian in the early stage.

If he used his hands, Erlangshen could push him to the ground and rub him with one hand.

He didn't want to make Erlang Shen angry, so he had to vent his anger on the gods around him.

"What are you still doing? Are the wooden figures good-looking? Why don't you activate the formation to transport these wastes... Oh no! Teleport them here!" Taibai Jinxing turned his head to look at them. It could be seen from his expression that he was indeed very angry with Erlang Shen.

The gods around him were obviously frightened by Taibai Jinxing who turned against him faster than turning the pages of a book. They all looked pale and hurriedly prepared the teleportation formation.

After a while...

"Buzz!"

As the Shusheng array trembled slightly, the people wrapped in the array had changed. Their bodies were exuding the same golden light as the previous dragon, and their bodies were involuntarily floating forward.

Faced with this situation, although they could not move, their eyes widened. It was obvious that they were also panicked.

"Speed up!"

Seeing that the magic circle was operating normally, the gods used all their strength to activate the magic circle to speed up the formation.

I saw that the group of people were moving faster and faster, several times faster than their own speed. Soon, the people in front would reach the Nantian Gate.

"You cowardly little fellow is not worthy of seeing my true form."

Seeing that they were coming, Erlang Shen waved his sleeves, used magic to hide himself and left.

Taibaijinxing frowned when he saw Erlangshen leaving, then sighed and used magic to hide himself. Of course, the purpose was not to let those who were about to come up see him, but Taibaijinxing did not leave and watched in the dark.

After all, this is his mission. There is no reason to leave before it is completed. Although Erlangshen goes his own way, his mission is only to protect the law. Since the mission is completed, why not leave?, he doesn't want to waste time here.

"You are here to prepare to receive the people who are about to come up. When they are all assembled, explain the matters and rules to them, and then send them to the Suzaku Army as soon as possible without wasting time." Taibai Jinxing said in the dark.

"Yes! My lord," replied the immortals.

The remaining gods were speechless, but they had no choice. Who made them have a low level and low cultivation, so they could only do these dirty and tiring jobs. This is the rule of heaven!
